newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products rise, mogas, fuel up from late di.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products rise, mogas, fuel up from late di.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly firmer on Thursday, gas oil lifted by futures, while mogas and fuel oil recovered from Wednesday's closing lows.
Gasoline was slightly firmer than Wednesday's close, but little changed from 24 hours ago. One eurograde barge traded at $197 fob Rotterdam for delivery by May 15.
May swaps were offered at around $196 fob ARA, against a $195 deal done late on Wednesday.
Heating oil barges gained $1 a tonne as IPE May gas oil futures rose. Offers for prompt remained at IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam. Storage material was about 50 cents cheaper.
German traders said there was some sign of improving end user demand.
High sulphur fuel oil rose over $2 higher than Wednesday's low. A single barge traded at $82 fob Rotterdam. Subsequent offers were at that level. Buyers were cautious.
